[EN] Find the {@linkcreature:183#2207#Old Tome} in Hall of Knowledge at Highwatch.
[ES] Encuentra el {@linkcreature:183#2207#Old Tome} en el Hall of Knowledge en Highwatch.

[EN] visits the Veritas Vault in Highwatch and reads about the history of the valkyries.
[ES] visita la Veritas Vault en Highwatch y lee sobre la historia de las valkyries.

[EN] (It looks like this book was moved recently.)Read the book.
[ES] (Parece que este libro fue movido recientemente.)Read the book.

[EN]
It was a cold night.

Thanksgiving was usually full of joy and happiness with the bright moonlight shining upon us. But that day was different.

The thought of something could go wrong wouldn't get out of my head. Something went wrong. Really wrong.

Mutated Poporis suddenly swarmed our farm. The grownups went out and fought. My sister and I were too little, so we stayed inside.
The villagers didn't stand a chance. There were too muny of them. Soon, the mutants came inside the farm.Read the next page.
[ES]
Era una noche fría.

El Thanksgiving solía estar lleno de alegría y felicidad con la brillante luz de la luna brillando sobre nosotros. Pero ese día fue diferente.

La idea de que algo pudiera salir mal no se me iba de la cabeza. Algo salió mal. Muy mal.

Poporis mutados rodearon repentinamente nuestra granja. Los adultos salieron a luchar. Mi hermana y yo éramos demasiado pequeños, así que nos quedamos adentro.
Los aldeanos no tuvieron ninguna oportunidad. Había demasiados. Pronto, los mutantes entraron a la granja.Read the next page.

[EN]
I couldn't move. My sister had to grab my hand, drag me to the back door.
My sister threw me out the door and cried out

"Run! Don't look back!"

I did what she said. I didn't look back. I just ran.
But the mutants kept chasing me. I don't remember how long I kept running. I got tired and the mutants were getting closer.Read the next page.
[ES]
No podía moverme. Mi hermana tuvo que tomar mi mano y arrastrarme hacia la puerta trasera.
Mi hermana me arrojó por la puerta y gritó

"¡Corre! ¡No mires atrás!"

Hice lo que dijo. No miré atrás. Simplemente corrí.
Pero los mutantes seguían persiguiéndome. No recuerdo cuánto tiempo seguí corriendo. Me cansé y los mutantes se acercaban más.Read the next page.

[EN] When I fell down, it seemed as if the moonlight shimmered. It was almost as if the moon shattered into pieces.
But it wasn't the moon. A mutant fell down and before I could notice it, they were all gone.
When I woke up, a runeglaive and a letter were lying on the ground.

"Just as the moonlight guided my path to you, I hope this runeglaive will help you."

After I read the letter, I knew what to do. I grabbed the runeglaive and headed back. Back to Popolion.
(The next page is torn out.)

Quoted from [Valkyrie Journal], author unknownClose the book.
[ES] Cuando caí, parecía como si la luz de la luna brillara intensamente. Era casi como si la luna se hubiera hecho añicos.
Pero no era la luna. Un mutante cayó y antes de que pudiera darme cuenta, todos habían desaparecido.
Cuando desperté, una runeglaive y una carta estaban tiradas en el suelo.

"Así como la luz de la luna guió mi camino hacia ti, espero que esta runeglaive te ayude."

Después de leer la carta, supe qué hacer. Tomé la runeglaive y regresé. De vuelta a Popolion.
